headline: Ordinances on snow storage zoning, unauthorized water and sewer connections, and towing unauthorized vehicles.
summary: The agenda lists three proposed ordinances, including one adding a snow storage section to the zoning code. The other two cover city water, sewer and stormwater connections and letting police tow unauthorized vehicles at the owner's expense.
items: Add snow storage section 12.28.150 to zoning code
Engineering Department review of water, sewer and stormwater connections (2.12.110)
Police may tow unauthorized vehicles at owner's expense (10.08.070)
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148

**510-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 2.12.110 ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT is hereby amended by adding the following to subsection B:

6. The Department shall review and approve any connections to the city’s water, sewer and stormwater systems and to take enforcement and other appropriate action necessary to eliminate unauthorized connections to the city’s water, sewer and stormwater systems as provided in Section 11.20 WATER.

Sponsors:

Stephen Winslow

**512-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 10.08.070 PROHIBITIONS ON USE OF MOTORIZED VEHICLES is hereby amended by adding the following after subsection F:

G. In addition to any other penalty provided by law, unauthorized vehicles, whether or not registered under M.G.L. c. 90 or M.G.L. c. 90B may, in the discretion of a police officer, be towed and stored at the owner’s expense.

Sponsors:

Stephen Winslow
